VI.description: Donor probe for the IVI session refnum parts: an IVI instrument handle of class niRFSA as a front-panel control, as an indicator and as a diagram constant. NI's converter builds this one (the composer cannot - it is where the parts come from); harvest_parts.py then files the three parts under Refnum.IVIRef. The siblings ptypes.xml and ptypes-nidaq.xml did the same for the user-defined tag refnums.
